_why: FOUNDATION1e part 1 (the foundation design §3.1's census sentence, D212): the one list of the sites where a path decides today how a line goes on. `CourseCensusTests` holds it exactly: a source file of the driver, host, modules or app with a shape below that neither reads the course nor is named here fails, a count that differs fails, a named file that is gone or whose shape is gone fails, and `floor` is the least number of file and shape pairs found. Every site is `not yet moved`, its `row` the Part B row that adopts it (h for conversations, i for driven lines, as §10 lists them). `hands` is true where the site's own body opens a part and hands it words: row d-ii's later parts read it for every site that opens and hands words, and a caller or a planner that only chooses is false. `moving`, on each such site alone (FOUNDATION1d-ii part 4), says how its open moves the words: `moves`, through the keyed door, its delivery read from the destination's moved words; `part 5`, the driven carry-on and the refused open, d-ii's fifth part's; `unkeyed`, the hand-over and the curve, until rows f-v and h; `no move`, words handed to its own record or a fresh one, with no record left. `box` names the ended limit move's members that read the destination's moved words, until row f-vi retires the box. `paths` are the survey's paths A to N (the foundation survey §2.2). Paths L and M are not course decisions and are named so in `notDecisions`.

sites.what: the driven look's go-on of a record the planner chose, which falls back to a new part
the go-on's resume and the limit resume's step 1, each asking the account rule
the new part's `from`, in order hand-over, limit, curve, retry, carry-on
the driven look's answers-alone hold before a go-on
the driven go-on: the judge, the resume and the words taken off
a quest's hand-over: the person's box and the agent's ask, with the consent before the ask
the page's and the terminal's hand-over press on a quest's session, writing its box
the driven limit resume: which record, its word keyed by the cool-off
a record ended past its transient bound
the planner's go-on, carry-on, limited carry-on and transient hold
the planner's reading of a record ended past its transient bound
go on in a new session: a conversation refused and pointed to start-from, a driven record's choice written for the next look
a conversation's go-on and Ask Daoris's, each asking the account rule without walking
the answers-alone hold before a conversation's resume
the go-on handing a lost or cooling conversation to the ended limit move or the briefed move
a helper's answer held at the bound before it goes on
the supervisor's door refusing a decision while the line stands at the bound
the live limit move and the ended one, each opening a briefed new part and handing the refused turns' words
the limit wake moving a limited conversation
the briefed move, and its not-offered path opening a fresh start of the actor
a conversation's hand-over and the curve's, which open the new part with the brief only
a conversation's hand-over at the turn's end, with its closing turn
the curve move: the decision, the scope's switch and the hand-over it asks
the replacement of a conversation whose model the account did not offer
the runner's briefed press, lost go-on and closed quest's cooling go-on handing to a move
the runner's doors for start-from, start-with, the briefed move and the lost go-on
a workflow's send-back and a go-on with findings: a word the dispatcher owns, an ended chat going on as path B
start-from: a fresh conversation with no `from` and a preface, its record the moves' source
start a conversation with these words

box.why: the ended limit move's body, its delivery and its come-up's take-up, each reading the destination's moved words where the box says the open moved them (O6-F13), until row f-vi retires the box

notDecisions.why: A workflow's send-back is a word between turns that the dispatcher owns; an ended conversation's go-on from it is path B, with B's own-account rule.
SWITCHCTX1's carry is a move's `how`, not a decision; it has no code yet, so the census reserves it and fails the day a source writes a carried move.
